candidates.name: Ontario-Hotel-Performance-Analysis
candidates.what_it_holds: Monthly Occupancy %, ADR, and RevPAR for hotels across Ontario, Canada regions/cities (Greater Toronto Area, North Western Ontario, etc.), Feb 2023-Dec 2025, sourced from the Ontario Open Data Portal (originally separate monthly Excel sheets, cleaned into a Power BI model). Repo holds a Datasets folder, a Hotel Performance Report.pbix, and a PDF report. MIT licensed.
candidates.why_useful: A real government-sourced, regional hotel RevPAR/ADR/occupancy series for a non-US market (Canada) at sub-national geography, which is more granular than the MAR/HLT RevPAR-from-releases we already hold and touches gap #8 (hotel supply/demand, regional RevPAR) and gap #7 (regional travel volume outside US/EU, Canada StatCan-adjacent). Read-across to short-term-rental competition and Canadian travel demand for ABNB.
candidates.size_hint: Unspecified row count; monthly panel across multiple Ontario regions/cities over ~3 years (small, tens to low hundreds of rows)
candidates.last_activity: not confirmed exactly; recent (2026 based on data coverage through Dec 2025)
candidates.duplicate_of_holding: Extends but does not duplicate the MAR/HLT RevPAR-from-releases we hold (that is company-level, this is Canadian regional/government-sourced)

candidates.name: host-hotels-and-resorts
candidates.what_it_holds: A third-party 'API profile' catalog entry for Host Hotels & Resorts (HST), a lodging REIT. Contains only company/API metadata (apis.yml, provenance.yml, README) and explicitly states no public API exists for the company. No financial, RevPAR, or portfolio data present.
candidates.why_useful: Not directly useful as-is (no data), but flags that api-evangelist (github.com/api-evangelist) maintains similar catalog-only profile repos for many hotel REITs (Service Properties Trust, Gaming & Leisure Properties) that could be scanned for any that DO have public data/APIs listed, and confirms none of the major hotel REITs expose a public API.
candidates.size_hint: tiny metadata repo, no data files

notes: This theme was largely a dead end under the tool constraints hit in this run: the shared WebSearch budget (200/200) was already exhausted before any query in this session could run, html.duckduckgo.com/html and lite.duckduckgo.com/lite returned 403 on every attempt, Bing's WebFetch rendering returns only a generic github.com info card (no actual organic results) for github-scoped queries, Startpage is unreachable via WebFetch, Yandex serves a CAPTCHA to WebFetch, and Marginalia rate-limits bot traffic. github.com/search?type=repositories itself returned HTTP 429 (retry-after 3600) after 3 calls. Fell back to `gh api search/repositories` (GitHub's REST search API), which has its own separate 30/min quota shared across all concurrent scout agents in this sweep and was exhausted and refilled twice during this run; roughly 30 distinct keyword queries were run against it (hotel REIT RevPAR, Marriott/Hilton/Hyatt pipeline, loyalty program data, SEC EDGAR XBRL hotel REIT, STR Global/CoStar scrapers, lodging tax/transient occupancy datasets, construction pipeline trackers, AirDNA export samples, franchise disclosure documents, Vrbo/Sonder/Vacasa data, Wyndham/Choice/IHG data) and the overwhelming majority returned zero results. The handful of non-zero results were all generic Power BI/Excel coursework dashboards built on the fictional 'AtliQ Grands' Codebasics training dataset (not real chain data) or boilerplate hotel-management CRUD apps (github.com/topics/hotel-management) - excluded per instructions as generic ML/BI boilerplate with no real data. github.com/topics/reit surfaced 'api-evangelist' company-profile repos for several hotel REITs (Host Hotels & Resorts, Service Properties Trust, Gaming and Leisure Properties) but these are metadata-only catalog entries with no financial data and explicitly note no public APIs exist for these companies - only one flagged as low-value pointer. The one real find, NebilDivay/Ontario-Hotel-Performance-Analysis, surfaced via the github.com/topics/reit adjacency browse rather than direct search. CONCLUSION: real, structured hotel-REIT/chain unit-count/pipeline/loyalty-member data does not appear to exist on GitHub in committed or easily-scraped form under any of the ~30+ query variants tried; this is consistent with such data being proprietary (STR Global, Lodging Econometrics, CBRE) or locked in REIT quarterly supplemental PDFs/10-Qs that nobody has yet parsed into a public repo. A follow-up scout with a working WebSearch budget, or one willing to manually parse SEC EDGAR XBRL company-facts for the ~8 public hotel REITs (HST, RHP, PEB, SVC, APLE, DRH, XHR-successor, SHO) and the three major chains' 10-K unit-count tables directly (bypassing GitHub entirely, going straight to SEC EDGAR's free API), would likely do better than continuing to search GitHub for this specific theme.
